title: Rabbi Yitzchak Ravya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah, at the supplied locator פ״ד־יב [compare [20:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.20.12)]: he says that Adam’s garments were smooth like a fingernail and beautiful like pearls. Hyman cites Tanchuma, Bereshit 25, for the same teaching: R’ Abbahu reports what R’ Yitzchak used to say. Hyman suggests that the name may need to read R’ Yitzchak Ruba.

notes.text: The supplied locator is פ״ד־יב; the earlier draft expanded it to84:12. The matching complete paragraph is Bereshit Rabbah20:12. The source locator remains unresolved; the Ravya-to-Ruba change is Hyman’s suggestion.

The saved whole TE BereshitRabbah20:12 scalar explicitly names full Rabbi Yitzchak Ravya and the garments smooth like a fingernail and beautiful like pearls. It supports that exact name/title and match beside supplied פ״ד־יב, without proving a dalet/kaf print substitution; the older84:12 conversion was unsupported. TanchumaBereshit25 remains Hyman’s uninspected comparison; Abbahu’s exact title and the proposed Ruba form stay R'. Hyman’s possible should-read emendation remains tentative, not an adopted Great epithet or identity merge.

Bereshit Rabbah 20:12 names Rabbi Yitzchak Ravya in the garment comparison and then gives a separate linen comparison under the name Rabbi Yitzchak. The Buber edition of Tanchuma, Bereshit 24, gives the fingernail and pearl comparison as Rabbi Abbahu reporting Rabbi Yitzchak. The consulted Tanchuma wording gives Rabbi Yitzchak without either Ravya or Ruba. Hyman’s locator 25 and his tentative Ruba conjecture are retained.
